description: How the Tree of Life tarot spread works: ten cards on the Kabbalistic tree, what each position asks, and how to read it without studying Kabbalah.
lede: The Tree of Life tarot spread arranges ten cards on the Kabbalistic tree. Each position becomes a plain question, read from the practical present up to the highest aim.

layout.alt: Ten gold-edged tarot cards in the shape of the Tree of Life under the heading A Tree of Life tarot spread. Card 1 Crown is at the top centre, 2 Wisdom upper right, 3 Understanding upper left, 4 Mercy mid-right, 5 Severity mid-left, 6 Beauty at the centre, 7 Victory lower right, 8 Glory lower left, 9 Foundation low centre and 10 Kingdom at the bottom centre.
layout.caption: Ten cards form three columns, with Beauty at the centre where the two sides meet. Read from the Kingdom upward, or from the Crown down.
